scope: Preserve the exact independently verified live-completion documentation checkpoint without rewriting its historical commit.

defects.rootCause: The completion documentation checkpoint omitted its required source-bound engineering plan.
defects.detectionGap: The prior push did not run the full PR-history engineering preflight; a later immediate-parent check could not detect it.
defects.regression: Pin exact historical commit, regular path and before/after blobs, digest and reviewed supplemental plan hash; retain ordinary plan validation and deny altered inputs.
defects.historicalPrevention: Run full-main-base engineering preflight before every push, including documentation checkpoints; include their bound change plan before committing.

qualification: Retrospective reviewed documentation record only, never a historical CI pass, execution grant or review-policy exception.
